explication: Darkbloom is a decentralized private-inference network: consumers submit OpenAI-compatible requests, the coordinator authenticates, routes and bills them, and provider Macs run inference in-process before streaming results back. The repository also includes a user console and an administrative UI for provider, account, network and payment operations. The README documents security and attestation paths; the sampled source excerpts are partial, so unverified internal wiring is intentionally omitted.
